name: @rogerchappel/policydiff
description: Local-first CLI that turns JSON/YAML policy changes into reviewer-ready risk summaries.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js compare fixtures/before fixtures/after --format text; code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ] && [ $code -ne 2 ]; then exit $code; fi; node dist/src/cli.js compare fixtures/before fixtures/after --format json --output /tmp/policydiff-smoke.json; code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ] && [ $code -ne 2 ]; then exit $code; fi; node dist/src/cli.js explain /tmp/policydiff-smoke.json --format markdown
scripts.release:check: npm run package:identity && npm run docs:check && npm run release:contract && npm run check && npm test && npm run smoke && npm run package:smoke

author: Roger Chappel
